**The paper we talked about**

## <https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5444764/>

Libraries

```{r}
library(Seurat)
  library(lme4)
  library(car)
```

Read in data

```{r}
obj <- readRDS('/Users/ggraham/Desktop/snRNA-seq R Files 122524/RNA Object.rds')

```

Extract expression of these two genes from data slot

```{r}
hsd3b1_expression = obj@assays$RNA$data['hsd3b1',]
hsd17b14_expression = obj@assays$RNA$data['hsd17b14',]

```

Model with a random effect of individual to account for variation

```{r}
mod <- lmer(hsd3b1_expression~hsd17b14_expression + (1|obj$individual))
summary(mod)
car::Anova(mod, type = 'III')


```

Simple Plot

```{r}
plot(x = hsd17b14_expression, y = hsd3b1_expression)

```
